messages:
Priya: Heads-up — post-publish problem: a syndicated outlet included PartnerX raw numbers from our PR kit that we explicitly asked to omit. Need rapid correction + patch to the live post. Link: https://blog.redwood/optimize-bench (live) Dan: Oh no. Which outlet? I'll reach out to the reporter and editor now. Priya: TechWire syndicated it and pulled the partner table. They used our PR kit attachment. Zoe: Legal here. We should request a correction framed as a clarification (no admission of fault). I'll draft the legal-safe language for the outreach and the internal note. Ravi: From Product: our public figures are accurate but partner raw metrics were not cleared for syndication. We should remove the partner table from the blog and add a short clarification footnote. Priya: I'm editing the post now. Patch command to CMS (manual fallback): ``` # patch live post to remove partner table + add footnote curl -X PATCH https://console.redwood/api/content/slug/optimize-bench \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $PUBLISH_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"ops":[{"op":"remove","path":"/content/blocks/partner_table"},{"op":"add","path":"/content/blocks/-","value":{"type":"html","html":"

Clarification: partner raw metrics were provided for internal validation and are not for publication; a summary line is used instead.

"}}]}' ``` Dan: Drafting outreach to TechWire editor: "Hi — quick clarification for your syndicated piece..." Will include Zoe's legal wording and request an editor's note + removal of the table. press-bot: Sent: correction_request_email to techwire_editor@techwire.com at 11:05 UTC. Zoe: Draft to include: "Please remove the PartnerX raw metrics table from the syndicated article and replace it with this summary line: 'PartnerX provided a summary comparison; raw partner metrics were not for public distribution.' Thank you." Keep it formal. Ravi: Also update social: pin an "Update/Clarification" thread and update the first tweet to reference the footnote. I'll hand the exact copy to Priya in 5m. Priya: Blog patched and footnote added. Pushing the change now. Ops: CDN purge scheduled for T+00:02 and executed. Syndication feeds flagged; we also sent the correction to our syndication partners list. Dan: TechWire replied: editor confirmed table removal and said they'll add an editor's note in the morning edition. I'll follow up to confirm the editor's note copy. Priya: Good. Next: internal comms to Sales and Partner teams so they can address customer questions. Zoe, can you approve the internal template? Zoe: Approved. Template: short context + FAQ + who to escalate to (Priya/Dan). No legal admissions. Rina: Sales notified. I'll add a short Q&A for AE heads and push to the sales slack. Priya: Thanks all. Final checklist: 1) live post patched ✅ 2) CDN purge ✅ 3) TechWire correction in progress ✅ 4) social update pinned ✅ 5) internal comms sent ✅. Closing thread unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
